method.encoding: Yjs v1; default gc=true; fixed producer clientID=1398; no compression; byteLength exact
method.data: Deterministic generator, 3 equally distributed collections (remainder assigned summaries then issues), 25 top-level fields, nested labels/metrics/extra, short synthetic notes or 4096 ASCII-character notes
method.updates: Initial write to empty document; append one generated summaries record with next ordinal; correct summaries-000000.value to 9999 after append; one local transaction each
method.apply: Y.applyUpdate only timed with performance.now; initial applies to fresh doc, append to fresh doc preloaded with initial state, correction to fresh doc preloaded with post-append state; setup excluded; 5 warmups plus 30 measured samples, median lower middle (sample 15), p95 nearest rank (sample 29)
method.scope: Microbenchmarks and direct storage APIs, not network or end-to-end latency; no production index work, scheduler, hub debounce, authentication, compression or competing workload
method.storage: Fresh actual MirrorStore and HubDatabase files for each case; inspect SQLite BLOB lengths; filenames/files/wal sizes separate; no vacuum; stores and readers closed then disposable directory removed

storageGrowth.cadence: Unpaced sequential initial write then 10 corrections; one transaction per correction; hub snapshot upsert awaited after every update
storageGrowth.compaction: Harness calls existing MirrorStore.compact at 500 logged rows, mirroring default threshold, rather than waiting for ReplicaEngine scheduling
storageGrowth.recoveryAssertions: Local snapshot + log tail and hub snapshot both reconstruct the final logical dataset

convergence.conclusion: Transactions batch local events; concurrent conflict resolution happens per key, so different-key rows survive under one winning schema. A whole envelope keeps its own schema/rows together by losing the competing envelope, including its row.
